basic_details.job_title: CSVTU Faculty Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Professor, Associate Professor Posts
basic_details.application_mode: Online, followed by hard copy through registered / speed post
basic_details.short_information: Three regular faculty posts (two of Professor and one of Associate Professor) in the Department of Computer Science & Engineering of Chhattisgarh Swami Vivekanand Technical University (CSVTU), Bhilai are open for online application. The Professor post carries Pay Level 14 with an entry pay of ₹144200/-, and the Associate Professor post carries Level 13A1 with an entry pay of ₹131400/-. Applications can be submitted on www.csvtu.ac.in from 18 November 2026, 11.00 a.m. to 19 December 2026, 05:30 p.m. The hard copy, with self-attested documents, must reach the University by registered or speed po

experience and good academic record or any other condition it deems fit. Mere eligibility will not entitle a candidate to be shortlisted. how_to_apply: Apply online through the University website www.csvtu.ac.in between 18/11/2026, 11.00 a.m. and 19/12/2026, 05:30 p.m. A user manual for form submission is available on the University website.

Upload the appropriate documents clearly, as given in the online application form, making sure they are clearly visible and in the appropriate format. Applications without proper uploads will not be considered.
Pay the non-refundable fee during online form submission.
Take the printout / hard copy of the application form and attach self-attested copies of all supporting documents.
Write on the envelope: "Application form for the post of ........ in the department of ........ vide advertisement number ........ dated ........".

Send the envelope by registered / speed post only so that it reaches the University on or before 04/01/2027, 05:30 p.m., at: The Registrar, (Recruitment Cell), Chhattisgarh Swami Vivekanand Technical University, Newai, Bhilai, Distt-Durg (C.G.) 491107.
Only application forms submitted online through the CSVTU website will be accepted. The University is not responsible for delay in submission or receipt, and late applications will not be considered.

content_sections.text: Reservation will be provided only to domiciled candidates of Chhattisgarh as per the norms of the Government of Chhattisgarh. Applicants from a reserved category should produce a caste certificate issued by the competent authority of the Government of Chhattisgarh.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The discipline for both posts is Engineering & Technology. Each post's minimum qualification, experience and research contribution is given below as printed. a. Ph.D. degree in relevant field and First class or equivalent at either Bachelor's or Master's level in the relevant branch. AND b. Minimum of 10 years of experience in teaching / research / industry, out of which at least 3 years shall be at a post equivalent to that of an Associate Professor. AND c. At least 6 research publications at the level of Associate Professor in SCI journals / UGC / AICTE approved list of journals and at least 2 successful Ph.D. guided as Supervisor / Co-supervisor till the date of eligibility of promotion, OR at least 10 research publications at the level of Associate Professor in SCI journals / UGC / AICTE approved list of journals till the date of eligibility of promotion. a. Ph.D. degree in the relevant field and First class or equivalent at either Bachelor's or Master's level in the relevant branch. AND b. At least total 6 research publications in SCI journals / UGC / AICTE approved list of journals. AND c. Minimum of 8 years of experience in teaching / research / industry, out of which at least 2 years shall be Post Ph.D. experience. Fulfilment of the minimum eligibility criteria is subject to verification of the submitted qualification, experience and research contribution documents. Eligibility and any other shortlisting criteria will be considered as on the last date of submission of the online application form. A Ph.D. acquired directly after B.E./B.Tech. is accepted provided the degree is in the relevant discipline from a recognized University following the process of registration, course work and evaluation as prescribed by UGC, or has been awarded by an Institute of national importance (IITs/IISc/NITs etc.) duly recognized by the MHRD. The candidate should also have at least first class at Bachelor's level in Engineering/Technology. If a class or division is not awarded, a minimum of 60% marks in aggregate is treated as equivalent to first class. Where a Grade Point System is used, CGPA is converted as below (reference: AICTE Notification, New Delhi, dated 1st March 2019, clause 7.3). Research papers must be published in SCI journals OR UGC approved journals OR the AICTE approved list of journals OR journals jointly approved by AICTE with respective councils / institutes such as the Council of Architecture / Institute of Town Planners, India. The degree must be in the appropriate / relevant branch of specialization. Inter-disciplinary courses at both UG and PG level may be considered, and the selection committee may take the final decision depending on the requirement of the programme of study and the institution. If a specialization is not available in the AICTE basket, the Board / University shall decide the equivalence based on the curriculum of the programme. content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Age will be calculated as on 01/01/2026 from the date of birth. The notice prints no minimum age for either post.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is non-refundable and is to be paid during online form submission, for processing of the application. A candidate applying for more than one post must submit a separate application form with the required processing fee for each post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on performance in academic record assessment and interview, as decided by the University. The University may shortlist applications for interview on the basis of good academic record, and may restrict the number of candidates called to a reasonable number on the basis of qualifications, experience and good academic record or any other condition it deems fit. Mere eligibility will not entitle a candidate to be shortlisted. Applicants with higher qualification and good academic record shall be given preference. The interview schedule and the list of shortlisted candidates will be published on the University website. No individual communication will be sent. No request for postponement of the interview date will be entertained. Candidates invited for interview must follow the instructions in the interview call letter and bring original certificates; those coming without originals will not be permitted to appear.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSVTU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Only application forms submitted online through the CSVTU website will be accepted. The University is not responsible for delay in submission or receipt, and late applications will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Printout of the online application form Self-attested copies of documents on academic / research performance Self-attested copies of academic credentials and accomplishments Other relevant annexures Photograph (applications without certificates, documents, photograph or required fee will be rejected) Caste certificate from the competent authority of the Government of Chhattisgarh, for reserved category applicants Certificates of academic / research performance, academic credentials and accomplishments NOC from the employer, for applicants who are in employment Proof of date of birth and relevant experience Aadhar card / PAN card Other relevant annexures

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CSVTU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 posts in the Department of Computer Science & Engineering: 2 Professor (UR 1, ST 1) and 1 Associate Professor (ST 1). The notice says the number of posts is tentative.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CSVTU Professor and Associate Professor posts?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 19 December 2026 at 05:30 p.m. The hard copy with self-attested documents must reach the University by registered or speed post on or before 4 January 2027, 05:30 p.m.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the CSVTU Professor post?
faq.answer: A Ph.D. in the relevant field with First class or equivalent at Bachelor's or Master's level in the relevant branch, 10 years of teaching/research/industry experience (3 years at Associate Professor level), and 6 research publications with 2 Ph.D. guided, or 10 research publications.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for CSVTU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 58 years for Professor and 50 years for Associate Professor, calculated as on 01/01/2026 from the date of birth.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of CSVTU Professor and Associate Professor?
faq.answer: The Professor post is in Level 14 with an entry pay of ₹144200/-, and the Associate Professor post is in Level 13A1 with an entry pay of ₹131400/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for CSVTU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The non-refundable fee is ₹5000/-, and ₹3000/- for SC/ST candidates of CG Domicile, paid during online form submission.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is based on academic record assessment and interview. The University may shortlist applications on the basis of good academic record, and the interview schedule and shortlist will be published on the University website.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for both Professor and Associate Professor posts?
faq.answer: Yes. A candidate applying for more than one post must submit a separate application form with the required processing fee for each post.

faq.question: Q9. Is the CSVTU faculty recruitment permanent?
faq.answer: The posts are being filled on regular basis, and selected candidates will be on probation for three years from the date of joining.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be admissible to candidates for appearing in the interview.
